The '''Royal Treasury''' was located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]] prior to its [[Destruction of Alderaan/Legends|destruction]]. Several [[Standard month/Legends|months]] after the planet's destruction, one of [[Belinda Vog]]'s [[Vog Salvage, Inc.|salvagers]] discussed the rumor that the Royal Treasury had been found in [[the Graveyard]] with a shopkeeper in [[Isttu Village]].
